'''What changed:''' The same day the PC re-uploaded the card turned 90° to landscape, the way location cards are shown (holotable 703095c, “Rotate locations”, PNG 980×703; then 611e293, “virtual 14”, the same PNG again and the first GIF copy, 745×534). Words, art and layout unchanged. A rotated re-upload is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026, 18:48).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Exegol: Sith Throne (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual14-Dark/large/exegolsiththrone.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/large/exegolsiththrone.gif holotable commit e8445f0], 1 June 2022); <code>Virtual14-Dark/hires/exegolsiththrone.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/exegolsiththrone.png holotable commit 13a5f3a], 31 May 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: No Force drains here. [Light Side] icons are canceled here. Your characters deploy +2 here. Dark: Once per game, may ▼ [Episode VII] Emperor here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-rendered the card (holotable 13a5f3a, “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”, 31 May 2022: PNG 1039×745; GIF copy e8445f0, “Fixing case and making gifs”, 1 June 2022, still 745×534). Most visibly: the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” in small capitals; the [Episode VII] icon moved from above the Set 14 icon at the lower left to the left border beside the art; the art credit now ends “@ ArtStation” (was “@ ArtStation.com”); art, frame and icons render slightly differently. Words unchanged.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Card image published 11 June 2022 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E3">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual14-Dark/large/exegolsiththrone.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/large/exegolsiththrone.gif holotable commit 6894629], 11 June 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: No Force drains here. [Light Side] icons are canceled here. Your characters deploy +2 here. Dark: Once per game, may ▼ [Episode VII] Emperor here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF copy (the file the PC card data uses) at a larger size, 745×534 → 1039×745 pixels, with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, 11 June 2022, which re-made the landscape GIFs of Virtual Sets 4 and 14–18 and 11 alternate-image cards; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name). It is the same card enlarged — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged; the new GIF is pixel-for-pixel the high-resolution PNG copy the PC had published on 31 May 2022 (<code>Virtual14-Dark/hires/exegolsiththrone.png</code>), which until then appeared only in the <code>hires</code> folder. A visible (resolution) change of the card image, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
